title: Beef Goulash Soup
ingredients: 400g (14oz) thin-cut lean beef steaks, cut into fine strips
1 red chilli, deseeded and finely chopped
TO SERVE: fat-free Greek yogurt, parsley leaves
method: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan (400°F), Gas Mark 6.

Spray a casserole dish (with a lid) with oil and fry the onions and celery for 10 minutes over a gentle heat until soft and golden. Stir in the beef, caraway seeds, garlic and chilli and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes, hot stock, tomato purée, vinegar, carrots and paprika, then season and stir.
Pop the lid on the pan and place it in the oven for 1.5 hours. Check that the beef is tender.
Use a hand blender to partly blend the soup to thicken it — don't completely purée it. Serve with a dollop of yogurt on top, plenty of parsley and a few grinds of pepper.
notes: To make into a stew, use bigger chunks of lean beef such as casserole steak and add big chunks of sweet potato and sliced red peppers.
